one_line: Sultan of Bengal who forged bold maritime diplomacy with Ming China, sending the famed giraffe tribute.

appearance.face: oval face, warm medium-brown Bengali complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, sharp almond eyes with confident gaze, default expression calm and diplomatic with a subtle half-smile.
appearance.hair: black hair kept short and tidy beneath a deep green Bengal-style turban wrapped low and smooth, with a narrow gold band at the base and a small white cloth tail tucked at the back.
appearance.costume: Over a long-sleeved knee-length jama (fitted tunic) of rich deep red silk with fine gold floral buta motifs, he wears a sleeveless dark green silk waistcoat with narrow gold piping; a wide cream cotton sash is wrapped firmly at the waist and knotted on his left side, from which a simple leather pouch hangs; his lower garment is loose cream cotton churidar trousers gathered neatly at the ankles, and his feet are in brown leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes and minimal tooling; a thin gold chain necklace and modest gold ring on his right hand complete the royal yet practical Bengal sultanate look.
appearance.signature: A sheathed straight-edged Indo-Persian sword with a simple cross-hilt and brown leather scabbard tipped in brass, worn at his left hip and often lightly held at the hilt as a symbol of authority rather than aggression.

ref_desc: Jalaluddin Muhammad Shah is a lean, bearded Bengali sultan with a deep green turban, red silk jama, green waistcoat, cream sash and trousers, brown mojari shoes, and a sheathed straight Indo-Persian sword in brown leather with brass tip, in a red-green-cream-gold palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Jalaluddin Muhammad Shah: a lean Bengali sultan in his early thirties with an oval face, medium-brown complexion, short neat black hair under a deep green turban, and a trimmed beard and moustache, wearing a rich deep red silk long-sleeved jama patterned with subtle gold floral buta, a dark green sleeveless waistcoat with narrow gold piping, a wide cream cotton sash knotted on his left side holding a small leather pouch, loose cream churidar trousers, and brown leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes; include a thin gold chain necklace and a modest gold ring, and show his straight-edged Indo-Persian sword sheathed in a brown leather scabbard with a brass tip at his left hip, his hand resting lightly on the hilt, all in a harmonious deep red, dark green, cream, brown, and gold colour scheme, posed in a calm, diplomatic stance.
